parameters.title: The item's main words.
parameters.subtitle: The line under the title.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.icon: A glyph at the start where there is no leading part.
parameters.value: A value at the end, before trailing (Monthly, 12 MB).
parameters.trailing: Places a widget at the trailing edge.
parameters.chevron: The chevron of a row that opens a page.
parameters.onTap: What a press on the row does.
parameters.onLongPress: What a long press does (the row's menu on a phone).
parameters.selected: Marks the row the page is about (the open thread).
parameters.onChanged: Asked for the other state when a selection row is pressed.
parameters.enabled: False draws the row disabled and inert.
parameters.semanticLabel: Names the component for a screen reader.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
